summary: The layout mostly conforms to the RTL dark theme specification, but minor truncation and alignment issues affect the carousel card labels and tab overflow indicators.

issues.title: Filename truncation in carousel card
issues.description: The middle card title truncates awkwardly into the file extension due to constrained width.
issues.evidence: The second carousel item renders as 'العرض_التقديمي.tx...'.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line text wrapping or adjust item min-width.

issues.title: Overflow indicator vertical misalignment
issues.description: The tab bar dropdown icon does not align with the adjacent tab baseline.
issues.evidence: The downward caret icon to the left of '3 Audit' sits below the text baseline.
issues.suggestion: Center-align the dropdown icon vertically with tab labels.
